_comment: The eight Kanto gym badges as progression roles, in game order.
WHAT `level` MEANS. It is a LEVELLING LEVEL, not a message count and not days active.
With the recommended bot (Lurkr) a member earns 15-40 XP for a message, then cannot
earn again for 60 seconds - so the practical unit is ONE QUALIFYING MESSAGE PER MINUTE
of real conversation. Reactions earn nothing. Voice time can earn separately if enabled.
A level is a total-XP milestone, and how many messages a level costs depends on the XP
curve preset chosen in the bot; use https://lurkr.gg/levels/calculator to convert a
level into an expected message count once the curve is set.
WHICH PARTS OF THIS FILE ARE LIVE. `name`, `colour` and the order of this list are
APPLIED FOR REAL by `bin/fm-dc-setup.sh --badges docs/examples/discord-badges.json`,
which creates and updates the Discord roles themselves. `level` is NOT live: the
levelling bot owns the XP-to-role mapping in its own dashboard, so the number here is
the recorded intent and must be entered once in the bot to take effect. Change it here
too, so the file and the bot never disagree about what was intended.
ICONS, LATER. `icon` is empty on every row because custom role icons need Discord
Boost Level 2 (7 boosts). Drop a 64x64 PNG under 256kb beside this file, put its path
in `icon`, re-run with --badges, and the icons attach. Nothing else changes: no roles
are recreated and no thresholds move. Until the server reaches Level 2 the script says
so and applies the colours alone.
Recorded intent for the bot's own settings; entered once in its dashboard.
no_xp_channels lists channels where activity must earn nothing - the private Fleet
channels are automated posts, and a bot farming its own badges is the failure mode
this exists to prevent.
earning_rules.level_up_announcement_note: Off deliberately. A promotion every level in a busy channel is the noise that makes a channel unread; the role appearing beside the name is the reward.
